title: Mean hour of demand in Dominion's Virginia zone
source: Source: EIA, Hourly Electric Grid Monitor (EIA-930), demand by subregion. The mean hour of demand in PJM's Dominion zone (DOM), local years 2019-2025, as PJM reports it to EIA; a change of the zone's bounds or of PJM's reporting would move the level.
_numbers_from: shortlist section 1; https://github.com/SamuelEnrique/erw/blob/main/docs/findings/demand/sub-mean-pjm-sub-dom.reproduce.py run 2026-11-24 on eia930_subba_demand_hourly_2019 to _2025, output runs/posts9900/c/s1.out
